entries.title: Lamentations 4:1
segments: How is the gold become dim! [how] is the most pure gold changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:2
segments: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

entries.title: Lamentations 4:3
segments: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: The daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:4
segments: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:5
segments: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: They that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:6
segments: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were laid upon her.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:7
segments: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was as of sapphire.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:8
segments: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:9
segments: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:10
segments: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:11
segments: Jehovah hath accomplished his wrath, he hath poured out his fierce anger; And he hath kindled a fire in Zion, which hath devoured the foundations thereof.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:12
segments: The kings of the earth believed not, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:13
segments: [It is] because of the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:14
segments: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood, So that men cannot touch their garments.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:15
segments: Depart ye, they cried unto them, Unclean! depart, depart, touch not! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, They shall no more sojourn [here].

entries.title: Lamentations 4:16
segments: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; he will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:17
segments: Our eyes do yet fail [in looking] for our vain help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:18
segments: They hunt our steps, so that we cannot go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:19
segments: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens: They chased us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:20
segments: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:21
segments: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass through unto thee also; thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

entries.title: Lamentations 4:22
segments: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will uncover thy sins.
